title: Minimax Rates for Optimal Treatment Value with a Growing Menu of Lipschitz Arms
banked_reason: D0.5 kernel_substituted@oeq:sharp-frontier: the promised matched explicit minimax frontier remains open; delivered q-to-u bracket is incremental below the field floor.
gap_reasons: The promised matched explicit minimax frontier with attaining estimator and honest interval remains open; the delivered bracket is a weaker object and must be positioned as such rather than as the proposed answer.

The delivered theorem is a uniform same-class bracket for point risk and honest interval length, with lower order q_{n,K} and upper order u_{n,K}; it does not determine the answer-open common minimax rate r_{n,K}.
proof_attempt_summary: The run derived a same-class spatial lower bound and an observable histogram upper bound for point risk and honest connected-interval length. D0.5 found that their logarithmic gap leaves the promised matched rate open, and graded the package incremental below the field floor. A future attempt needs a K-uniform maximum-estimation variance argument and a matching positive full-record prior; the local citation, small-K, and literature-positioning findings also remain to be repaired.
tldr: The optimal individualized-treatment value is an integrated maximum of \(K\) unknown Lipschitz Bernoulli regressions, and exact or shrinking ties make the functional nonregular. The project seeks the explicit common minimax rate for absolute error and honest connected-interval length in the deliberately fixed uniform-covariate, balanced-randomization experiment as \(K\) grows to \(n^{1/4}\). A finite histogram procedure gives order \(u_{n,K}\), while a full-record hidden-arm tent mixture gives order \(q_{n,K}\); the publishable kernel is to close the logarithmic gap through one \(K\)-uniform localized maximum correction and a matching positive spatial prior, with the transferred binary-treatment bracket and fixed-\(K\) softmax tradeoff serving as mandatory boundary checks.
gap: Fixed-action optimal-value inference relies on pointwise gap and nuisance conditions, polynomial contextual-bandit estimators retain dimension-dependent constants, and the matching nonsmooth-functional lower theorem excludes the pointwise-Lipschitz boundary. No primary source located gives a uniform growing-menu minimax rate and honest-length theorem for this Bernoulli causal experiment.
fill: The paper will derive the explicit rate \(r_{n,K}\), construct a finite estimator and honest interval attaining it, and prove all-procedure lower bounds on the identical class using full-record hidden-arm Lipschitz mixtures.
